_comment: Minimal fixture for the STM32F103 boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (RCC HSERDY/PLLRDY busy-wait satisfied by rcc_stub.py at 0x40021000), TIM2 advances generic/armcm_timer's view of the system clock, and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the USART1 pty Renode exposes.
